summary: Master the art of data analysis with our Applied Statistics for Data Science Course. Equip yourself with vital statistical tools for effective decision-making.
lede: Applied Statistics for Data Science equips professionals to separate meaningful signals from random variation and test whether findings are statistically significant. You will apply inferential statistics, hypothesis testing, effect-size analysis, power analysis, multivariate regression, and Bayesian inference to strengthen model validation. Using Python libraries such as SciPy and Statsmodels, you will create practical outputs including distribution profiles, correlation matrices, and predictive intervals. The course also addresses missing data, non-normal distributions, selection bias, and communicating uncertainty clearly, helping you produce analyses that are reproducible, scientifically sound, and defensible.
audienceIntro: This program is essential for professionals who must validate data patterns and ensure the mathematical rigor of their analytical outputs.
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of algebra and basic experience with data manipulation. Familiarity with Python or R is recommended but not required, as the course focuses on the application of statistical logic rather than complex programming.
topics: Data science & machine learning in practice
